request_to_C: Please review and, if approved, issue one explicit authorization for the single R2 diagnostic point below, bound to this proposal SHA and the exact source/runner/collector hashes.

frozen_science_parameters.paw: GPAW PAW; gpaw-data 1.2.1; fixed Ag/C/Si/Ti hashes

eigensolver.reason: R2 eigenstate residual remains high; the three prior attempts changed Mixer only and retained PPCG niter=2. GPAW 26.7.0 parameter syntax was checked without running DFT.
eigensolver.api_expression: from gpaw.dft import PPCG; GPAW(..., eigensolver=PPCG(niter=4))

max_scf_iterations.reason: finite upper bound only; the earlier maxiter increase to 240/300 did not itself produce convergence, so this is not claimed as the fix

checkpoint_and_failure_policy.checkpoint_policy: one rolling diagnostic checkpoint; save at completed SCF iterations and verify its SHA/readability; check free disk space before starting
checkpoint_and_failure_policy.if_wall_clock_or_maxiter_limit_reached: FAILED_SCF; preserve logs/checkpoint and stop; no retry
checkpoint_and_failure_policy.if_SCF_converges: collect total energy, force-consistent free energy, atomic forces, stress, SCF steps and SHA256SUMS, then compare with R1 under same fixed settings

expected_question: Does PPCG niter=4 stabilize the R2 eigenstate/density residuals under the frozen science parameters?
risk: The eigensolver work per SCF iteration and temporary memory use may rise; if density mixing is the dominant cause, this one point may still fail. No automatic second adjustment is allowed.
